metadata.title: आदिवासी स्वशासन प्रणाली के संवैधानिक प्रावधान | Constitutional Provisions for Tribal Self Rule
metadata.description: The tribal self-governance system is unique and distinct, which is why the Constitution provides special provisions for Scheduled Areas under a separate part. While discussing the Provisions of the Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996 (PESA), this fundamental aspect must be kept in mind. In this context, the Jharkhand Panchayati Raj Act cannot be applied in tribal areas. Renowned tribal rights activist Suresh Chandra Soy emphasized this point during his address at a recent PESA workshop.
